messages:
laura: Heads up — incoming enterprise RFP asking for per-model SKUs + per-tenant routing controls. We need a proposal for the roadmap sync next Tue. Short and actionable please.

sam: They want a low-friction onramp: small monthly commit, plus optional add-ons for priority routing and dedicated keystore. Will push for SLA.

priya: Agree on an onramp. We should avoid exploding SKU permutations. Proposal idea: keep 3 base tiers and expose 3 add-ons. Draft example below for discussion.

priya: ```json
{
  "tiers": [
    {"id": "dev", "monthly": "0", "tokens_included": "100k", "support": "community"},
    {"id": "pro", "monthly": "500", "tokens_included": "5M", "support": "email"},
    {"id": "enterprise", "monthly": "custom", "tokens_included": "custom", "support": "slA"}
  ],
  "add_ons": [
    {"id": "performance_pack", "includes": ["priority_routing","throughput_blocks"], "pricing": "flat or per-u"},
    {"id": "dedicated_keystore", "requires": "private_deploy", "pricing": "premium"},
    {"id": "embed_plus", "description": "higher-rate embedding compute", "pricing": "per-embed"}
  ],
  "billing_behaviour": {"softcap": "notify + overage_rate 1.25x", "hardcap": "customer opt-in only"}
}
```

michael: Engineering constraints to call out: dedicated_keystore only for Private (VPC/on-prem) and needs KMS/HSM integration + security review. Throughput_blocks map to reserved capacity units on Dedicated and require autoscaler hooks. Estimate: 2 sprints for billing plumbing + 1 sprint for console bits.

andy: Finance note: more add-ons -> more SKU permutations -> harder forecasting. Recommend bundling priority_routing + throughput_blocks into a single "performance_pack" to reduce permutations. Also run a sensitivity model for churn if we gate features behind expensive add-ons.

laura: Good point. Also customer explicitly asked for softcaps vs hard limits. They prefer softcaps with predictable overage (they wrote 1.25x). Would we be comfortable with that?

priya: Softcaps are PLG-friendly. Implementation: softcap = threshold trigger (email + console banner) + optional auto-upgrade path. Overage billing monthly at configured multiplier. Need product + finance acceptance criteria.

sam: They'll push for contractual latency SLA if they buy the performance_pack. We need launch criteria to include measurable SLOs and a fallback policy (model variant / region) in case of degradation.

michael: Proposed launch checklist (short):
- E2E billing integration (metering -> invoice)
- Console SKU selection & add-on flow + docs
- Automated regression + load tests hitting perf pack SLOs
- Canary rollout on Dedicated pool + fallback routing
- Security signoff for dedicated_keystore (if included)

priya: Also add metrics gating for GA: <=2% invoicing errors, <5% failed provision attempts, 95th latency within target for perf pack.

laura: OK. For the roadmap sync I'll present: proposed SKU matrix (3 tiers), performance_pack bundling, softcap policy, and launch criteria. Ask: can eng/finance confirm estimates and blockers by EOD Friday?

andy: Will run modeling and share numbers by Fri. Recommend we also price a short-term promo for onramp commits to reduce friction.

michael: I'll block time for the billing hooks and console mockups. Blocking item: need API version for add-on flags; will create RFC.

deploy-bot: created ticket PRD-3421 "SKU granularity & enterprise onramp — proposal" and linked ENG-998 / FIN-723.

sam: Thanks — I'll loop in the customer success rep and save the RFP language. :thumbsup:

laura: Great, thanks everyone. Short follow-up after numbers come in. :rocket:
